interpretationDecisions.decision: The low-light Rush route visibly finishes with medium punch (214MP); the triple-jab and forward-medium routes use light punch. Strengths follow the input glyphs, not the generic 214P chapter caption.

Heavy placement in the stun route is 22HP; the four corner reset branches use 22LP. 63214K is Backstep Rolling Attack, not Wild Hunt. All four corner branches visibly use low-health Critical Art and require the corresponding health condition.

The demonstrated prerequisite is j.HK > cr.HP > 2PP > P > 3HP. Forward hop uses back medium kick, not standing medium kick. The hit branch links crouching jab into light Electricity. The throw branch includes the blocked knee and forward walk.

Blanka visibly throws Ryu, but the original input display omits the throw-button chord. The authored action is generic Throw; no exact button chord or tick-throw timing is inferred. This limitation is visible in the reference verification note.
Blue block contact confirms guarding the recorded Jamie OD reversal. The recipe explicitly includes Guard and does not claim an unguarded low-profile evasion or universal reversal coverage.

A raw Rush plus two cancel Rushes is a nominal seven-bar spend across a route that starts from the shown gauge and finishes in burnout; no seven-bar gauge capacity is implied. Source +F labels describe advantage, not an invented wait.

Source crossfades are retained only when needed to preserve the first action. Unlisted practice jabs, next takes and replay transitions are trimmed out. Full original frame, HUD and input displays remain visible.
